Constantly reminds me that I can put an asterisk if I know how to spell something. As an example of its stupidity, when I type in “adumbration,” it shows no results although that is an entry under “adumbrate.”

By trying to add features and redesign it, the developers have ruined what was a very helpful app. Used to be an affordable monthly subscription, but then the price became so ridiculous that an annual subscription was the only reasonable option. reviews.title: What happened to the wildcard search?
reviews.text:
First of all, I’d like to say that I’ve used the app for a few years and, until recently, I thought it was great and worthy of 5 stars. However, the recent changes seem to have broken the wildcard search.

I’m using an iPhone 17 Pro, so I don’t think it has anything to do with my phone’s performance. Rather, it seems to be related to changes made to the way wildcard search works. The issue now is that if you start by entering, say, three question marks in the search box, you won’t be able to enter anything after that for a while because the app freezes. This is rather annoying, and it didn’t used to be like that—it worked smoothly and without freezing before.

The other thing that’s changed is that if you search for a word but then don’t select any of the matching results, and instead tap the cross in the search box to delete the typed word, the keyboard closes. That’s a little annoying because it removes focus from the search box.

It’s still a great app, but for someone who has used it for a few years, the recent changes seem to have made at least two things worse compared with how they worked before.

Notification permission is turned off. To receive vocabulary reminders, go to your phone’s Settings, find “Youdao Dictionary” under Notifications, and enable notifications.
